answer: Latent Trajectory Divergence Scoring. Each identity keeps an encrypted vault of hashed action traces per epoch. Joining epochs requires cosine similarity above threshold between consecutive trace vectors; a clone farm must synthesize consistent histories. An attacker can wander across cheap short-lived keys, but only by paying to curate matching multi-epoch traces for each, roughly the cost of running real distinct agents. Divergence flags trigger quarantine, so the orchard of fresh identities cannot rejoin without rebuilding that history.
